question_raw: Trong quý 4 năm 2025, chênh lệch tăng trưởng cổ phiếu GVR outperform hay underperform VN30 là bao nhiêu?
question: Trong quý 4 năm 2025, chênh lệch tăng trưởng của cổ phiếu GVR so với VN30 là bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH gvr_q4 AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_code,
        time,
        close,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) as rn_start,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
    FROM stock_daily
    WHERE stock_code = 'GVR'
        AND time >= '2025-10-01'
        AND time <= '2025-12-31'
),
vn30_q4 AS (
    SELECT 
        index_name,
        time,
        close,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) as rn_start,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
    FROM indices_daily
    WHERE index_name = 'VN30'
        AND time >= '2025-10-01'
        AND time <= '2025-12-31'
),
gvr_start_end AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_start = 1 THEN close END) as start_value,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_end = 1 THEN close END) as end_value
    FROM gvr_q4
),
vn30_start_end AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_start = 1 THEN close END) as start_value,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_end = 1 THEN close END) as end_value
    FROM vn30_q4
)
SELECT 
    gvr.start_value as gvr_start,
    gvr.end_value as gvr_end,
    ((gvr.end_value - gvr.start_value) / gvr.start_value * 100) as gvr_growth,
    vn30.start_value as vn30_start,
    vn30.end_value as vn30_end,
    ((vn30.end_value - vn30.start_value) / vn30.start_value * 100) as vn30_growth,
    ((gvr.end_value - gvr.start_value) / gvr.start_value * 100) - ((vn30.end_value - vn30.start_value) / vn30.start_value * 100) as difference_pct_points
FROM gvr_start_end gvr, vn30_start_end vn30;

question_raw: Liệt kê ROE theo từng quý của ngân hàng ACB và mức trung bình ngành Ngân hàng từ 2024-Q4 đến 2025-Q3.
question: Hãy liệt kê ROE (điểm phần trăm) theo từng quý của Ngân hàng Á Châu và mức trung bình của ngành ngân hàng từ quý 4/2024 đến quý 3/2025.
SQL:
SELECT 
    CONCAT(acb.year, '-Q', acb.quarter) AS period_key,
    acb.data * 100 AS company_ROE,
    ind.data * 100 AS industry_mean_ROE
FROM financial_ratio acb
JOIN financial_ratio ind 
    ON acb.year = ind.year 
    AND acb.quarter = ind.quarter
WHERE acb.stock_code = 'ACB'
    AND acb.ratio_code = 'ROE'
    AND acb.segment <> 'industry'
    AND ind.stock_code = 'Banking'
    AND ind.ratio_code = 'ROE'
    AND ind.segment = 'industry'
    AND (
        (acb.year = 2024 AND acb.quarter = 4)
        OR (acb.year = 2025 AND acb.quarter IN (1, 2, 3))
    )
ORDER BY acb.year, acb.quarter

question_raw: Liệt kê ROE theo từng quý của công ty HSG và mức trung bình ngành Tài nguyên Cơ bản từ 2024-Q4 đến 2025-Q3.
question: Liệt kê ROE (điểm phần trăm) theo từng quý của công ty HSG và mức trung bình ngành tài nguyên  từ quý 4/2024 đến quý 3/2025.
SQL:
SELECT 
    CONCAT(year, '-Q', quarter) AS "period_key",
    MAX(CASE WHEN stock_code = 'HSG' AND segment <> 'industry' THEN data * 100 END) AS "company_ROE",
    MAX(CASE WHEN stock_code = 'Basic Resources' AND segment = 'industry' THEN data * 100 END) AS "industry_mean_ROE"
FROM financial_ratio
WHERE ratio_code = 'ROE'
    AND (
        (year = 2024 AND quarter = 4)
        OR (year = 2025 AND quarter IN (1, 2, 3))
    )
    AND (stock_code = 'HSG' OR stock_code = 'Basic Resources')
GROUP BY year, quarter
ORDER BY year, quarter

SQL:
WITH company_roe AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        quarter,
        data * 100 AS company_ROE
    FROM financial_ratio
    WHERE stock_code = 'TPB'
        AND ratio_code = 'ROE'

)

    CONCAT(c.year, '-Q', c.quarter) AS period_key,

question_raw: Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng của Gia súc, gia cầm trong tháng 12 năm 2025 là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
question: Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng của Gia súc, gia cầm trong tháng 12 năm 2025 là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH monthly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    time,
    value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_start,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
  FROM commodities_daily 
  WHERE indicator_code = 'LE=F' 
    AND time >= '2025-12-01' 
    AND time < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  (MAX(CASE WHEN rn_end = 1 THEN value END) - MIN(CASE WHEN rn_start = 1 THEN value END)) 
  * 100.0 / MIN(CASE WHEN rn_start = 1 THEN value END) as growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_data

question: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, chênh lệch sinh lời giữa cổ phiếu HPG và VN30 là bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH hpg_data AS (
  SELECT stock_code, time, close
  FROM stock_daily 
  WHERE stock_code = 'HPG' 
    AND time >= '2025-07-01' 
    AND time <= '2025-09-30'
),
v30_data AS (
  SELECT index_name, time, close
  FROM indices_daily 
  WHERE index_name = 'VN30' 
    AND time >= '2025-07-01' 
    AND time <= '2025-09-30'
),
hp_return AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT close FROM hpg_data ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) as hpg_end,
    (SELECT close FROM hpg_data ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) as hpg_start
),
v30_return AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT close FROM v30_data ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) as v30_end,
    (SELECT close FROM v30_data ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) as v30_start
)
SELECT 
  (hpg_end - hpg_start) / hpg_start * 100 as hpg_return_pct,
  (v30_end - v30_start) / v30_start * 100 as v30_return_pct,
  (hpg_end - hpg_start) / hpg_start * 100 - (v30_end - v30_start) / v30_start * 100 as difference_pct_points
FROM hp_return, v30_return;

question_raw: Liệt kê Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng theo từng quý của mã cổ phiếu công ty NHA và VNINDEX từ 2025-Q1 đến 2025-Q4.
question: Hãy liệt kê Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng (điểm phần trăm) theo từng quý cho mã cổ phiếu NHA và VNINDEX từ Q1/2025 đến Q4/2025
SQL:
WITH quarterly_ends AS (
  SELECT '2024-Q4' as quarter, '2024-12-31'::date as end_date
  UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q1', '2025-03-31'::date
  UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q2', '2025-06-30'::date
  UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q3', '2025-09-30'::date
  UNION ALL SELECT '2025-Q4', '2025-12-31'::date
),
nha_quarterly AS (
  SELECT q.quarter, q.end_date, sd.close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q.quarter ORDER BY sd.time DESC) as rn
  FROM quarterly_ends q
  JOIN stock_daily sd ON sd.time::date <= q.end_date
  WHERE sd.stock_code = 'NHA'
    AND sd.time >= (q.end_date - INTERVAL '3 months')::date
    AND sd.time <= q.end_date
),
vnindex_quarterly AS (
  SELECT q.quarter, q.end_date, sd.close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q.quarter ORDER BY sd.time DESC) as rn
  FROM quarterly_ends q
  JOIN indices_daily sd ON sd.time::date <= q.end_date
  WHERE sd.index_name = 'VNINDEX'
    AND sd.time >= (q.end_date - INTERVAL '3 months')::date
    AND sd.time <= q.end_date
),
nha_prices AS (
  SELECT quarter, close
  FROM nha_quarterly
  WHERE rn = 1
),
vnindex_prices AS (
  SELECT quarter, close
  FROM vnindex_quarterly
  WHERE rn = 1
),
nha_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    nha.quarter as period_key,
    (nha.close - LAG(nha.close) OVER (ORDER BY nha.quarter)) * 100.0 / LAG(nha.close) OVER (ORDER BY nha.quarter) as return_pct
  FROM nha_prices nha
),
vnindex_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    vn.quarter as period_key,
    (vn.close - LAG(vn.close) OVER (ORDER BY vn.quarter)) * 100.0 / LAG(vn.close) OVER (ORDER BY vn.quarter) as benchmark_return_pct
  FROM vnindex_prices vn
)
SELECT 
  nr.period_key,
  nr.return_pct,
  vr.benchmark_return_pct
FROM nha_returns nr
JOIN vnindex_returns vr ON nr.period_key = vr.period_key
WHERE nr.period_key IN ('2025-Q1', '2025-Q2', '2025-Q3', '2025-Q4')
ORDER BY nr.period_key

SQL:
WITH october_data AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT close FROM stock_daily WHERE stock_code = 'PAN' AND time >= '2025-10-01' AND time < '2025-11-01' ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) as pan_start,
        (SELECT close FROM stock_daily WHERE stock_code = 'PAN' AND time >= '2025-10-01' AND time < '2025-11-01' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) as pan_end,
        (SELECT close FROM indices_daily WHERE index_name = 'VNINDEX' AND time >= '2025-10-01' AND time < '2025-11-01' ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) as vnindex_start,
        (SELECT close FROM indices_daily WHERE index_name = 'VNINDEX' AND time >= '2025-10-01' AND time < '2025-11-01' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) as vnindex_end
)
SELECT 
    pan_start,
    pan_end,
    vnindex_start,
    vnindex_end,
    (pan_end - pan_start) * 100.0 / pan_start as pan_return_pct,
    (vnindex_end - vnindex_start) * 100.0 / vnindex_start as vnindex_return_pct,
    ((pan_end - pan_start) * 100.0 / pan_start) - ((vnindex_end - vnindex_start) * 100.0 / vnindex_start) as excess_return_pct_points
FROM october_data

question_raw: Tỷ suất sinh lời của mã cổ phiếu công ty KBC trong quý 3 năm 2025 so với quý 2 năm 2025 chênh lệch bao nhiêu phần trăm?
question: Tỷ suất sinh lời của cổ phiếu công ty phát triển đô thị Kinh Bắc trong quý 3/2025 so với quý 2/2025 chênh lệch bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH quarterly_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_code,
        time::date,
        close,
        CASE 
            WHEN time::date = '2025-04-01' THEN 'Q2_2025_Start'
            WHEN time::date = '2025-06-30' THEN 'Q2_2025_End'
            WHEN time::date = '2025-07-01' THEN 'Q3_2025_Start'
            WHEN time::date = '2025-09-30' THEN 'Q3_2025_End'
        END as period
    FROM stock_daily 
    WHERE stock_code = 'KBC' 
    AND time::date IN ('2025-04-01', '2025-06-30', '2025-07-01', '2025-09-30')
),
q2_return AS (
    SELECT 
        (MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'Q2_2025_End' THEN close END) - MIN(CASE WHEN period = 'Q2_2025_Start' THEN close END)) 
        * 100.0 / MIN(CASE WHEN period = 'Q2_2025_Start' THEN close END) as q2_return_pct
    FROM quarterly_prices
),
q3_return AS (
    SELECT 
        (MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'Q3_2025_End' THEN close END) - MIN(CASE WHEN period = 'Q3_2025_Start' THEN close END)) 
        * 100.0 / MIN(CASE WHEN period = 'Q3_2025_Start' THEN close END) as q3_return_pct
    FROM quarterly_prices
)
SELECT 
    q2_return_pct,
    q3_return_pct,
    q3_return_pct - q2_return_pct as difference_pct_points

question_raw: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, mức chênh lệch sinh lời giữa cổ phiếu POW và VN30 là bao nhiêu điểm %?
question: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, mức chênh lệch sinh lời giữa cổ phiếu của Tổng Công ty Điện lực Dầu khí Việt Nam (POW) và VN30 là bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH pow_data AS (
  SELECT stock_code, time, close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_start,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
  FROM stock_daily 
  WHERE stock_code = 'POW' 
    AND time >= '2025-07-01' 
    AND time <= '2025-09-30'
),
vn30_data AS (
  SELECT index_name, time, close,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_start,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
  FROM indices_daily 
  WHERE index_name = 'VN30' 
    AND time >= '2025-07-01' 
    AND time <= '2025-09-30'
),
prices AS (
  SELECT 
    pow_start.close as pow_start_price,
    pow_end.close as pow_end_price,
    vn30_start.close as vn30_start_price,
    vn30_end.close as vn30_end_price
  FROM pow_data pow_start
  JOIN pow_data pow_end ON pow_start.stock_code = pow_end.stock_code AND pow_end.rn_end = 1
  JOIN vn30_data vn30_start ON vn30_start.rn_start = 1
  JOIN vn30_data vn30_end ON vn30_end.rn_end = 1
  WHERE pow_start.rn_start = 1
)
SELECT 
  pow_start_price,
  pow_end_price,
  vn30_start_price,
  vn30_end_price,
  (pow_end_price - pow_start_price) / pow_start_price * 100 as pow_return_pct,
  (vn30_end_price - vn30_start_price) / vn30_start_price * 100 as vn30_return_pct,
  ((pow_end_price - pow_start_price) / pow_start_price * 100) - ((vn30_end_price - vn30_start_price) / vn30_start_price * 100) as difference_pct_points
FROM prices

    WHERE index_name = 'VNINDEX'
        AND time >= '2025-10-01'
        AND time <= '2025-12-31'
),
acb_start_end AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_start = 1 THEN close END) as acb_start,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_end = 1 THEN close END) as acb_end
    FROM acb_prices
),
vnindex_start_end AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_start = 1 THEN close END) as vnindex_start,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_end = 1 THEN close END) as vnindex_end
    FROM vnindex_prices
)
SELECT 
    acb_start,
    acb_end,
    vnindex_start,
    vnindex_end,
    (acb_end - acb_start) * 100.0 / acb_start as acb_return_pct,
    (vnindex_end - vnindex_start) * 100.0 / vnindex_start as vnindex_return_pct,
    ((acb_end - acb_start) * 100.0 / acb_start) - ((vnindex_end - vnindex_start) * 100.0 / vnindex_start) as excess_return_pct
FROM acb_start_end, vnindex_start_end;

extra_info.resolved_from_clear_question: Trong quý 4 năm 2025, tỷ suất sinh lời về giá của cổ phiếu PLX chênh Dầu Brent bao nhiêu điểm %?

question: Trong quý 4 năm 2025, tỷ suất sinh lời giá của cổ phiếu PLX so với giá dầu Brent là bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH plx_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        close,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_desc
    FROM stock_daily
    WHERE stock_code = 'PLX' 
        AND time >= '2025-10-01' 
        AND time < '2026-01-01'
),
brent_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_desc
    FROM commodities_daily
    WHERE indicator_code = 'BZ=F' 
        AND time >= '2025-10-01' 
        AND time < '2026-01-01'
),
plx_start AS (
    SELECT close as start_price FROM plx_prices WHERE rn_asc = 1
),
plx_end AS (
    SELECT close as end_price FROM plx_prices WHERE rn_desc = 1
),
brent_start AS (
    SELECT value as start_value FROM brent_prices WHERE rn_asc = 1
),
brent_end AS (
    SELECT value as end_value FROM brent_prices WHERE rn_desc = 1
),
returns AS (
    SELECT 
        (plx_end.end_price - plx_start.start_price) * 100.0 / plx_start.start_price as plx_return_pct,
        (brent_end.end_value - brent_start.start_value) * 100.0 / brent_start.start_value as brent_return_pct
    FROM plx_start, plx_end, brent_start, brent_end
)
SELECT 
    plx_return_pct,
    brent_return_pct,
    plx_return_pct - brent_return_pct as difference_percentage_points
FROM returns

question: Vẽ biểu đồ cột hiển thị mức sinh lời (điểm phần trăm) theo quý cho top 10 mã cổ phiếu ngân hàng trong 4 quý gần nhất.
SQL:
WITH bank_stocks AS (
    SELECT stock_code 
    FROM company_info 
    WHERE is_bank = true
),
latest_quarter AS (
    SELECT year, quarter 
    FROM financial_ratio 
    WHERE segment <> 'industry' 
    ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC 
    LIMIT 1
),
recent_quarters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, quarter 
    FROM financial_ratio 
    WHERE segment <> 'industry' 
    ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC 
    LIMIT 4
),
bank_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.stock_code,
        fr.year,
        fr.quarter,
        fr.data as roe_value,
        CONCAT(fr.year, '-Q', fr.quarter) as period_key
    FROM financial_ratio fr
    JOIN bank_stocks bs ON fr.stock_code = bs.stock_code
    WHERE fr.ratio_code = 'ROE'
    AND fr.segment <> 'industry'
    AND (fr.year, fr.quarter) IN (SELECT year, quarter FROM recent_quarters)
),
top10_banks AS (
    SELECT stock_code
    FROM bank_returns br
    JOIN latest_quarter lq ON br.year = lq.year AND br.quarter = lq.quarter
    ORDER BY roe_value DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    br.stock_code,
    br.period_key,
    br.roe_value * 100 as return_pct
FROM bank_returns br
JOIN top10_banks t10 ON br.stock_code = t10.stock_code
ORDER BY br.stock_code, br.year DESC, br.quarter DESC

question_raw: Lấy dữ liệu để vẽ biểu đồ hiển  tỷ suất sinh lời theo quý cho top 10 mã cổ phiếu của ngành Bán lẻ trong 4 quý gần nhất.
question: Vẽ biểu đồ đường hiển thị tỷ suất sinh lời theo quý cho top 10 mã cổ phiếu ngành Bán lẻ trong 4 quý gần nhất.
SQL:
WITH latest_quarters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, quarter
    FROM financial_ratio
    WHERE ratio_code = 'ROE'
      AND segment <> 'industry'
    ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC
    LIMIT 4
),
top_stocks AS (
    SELECT fr.stock_code, fr.data as latest_roe
    FROM financial_ratio fr
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT stock_code, MAX(year) as max_year, MAX(quarter) as max_quarter
        FROM financial_ratio
        WHERE ratio_code = 'ROE'
          AND segment <> 'industry'
          AND stock_code IN ('MWG', 'DHT', 'FRT', 'PSD', 'PET', 'DGW')
        GROUP BY stock_code
    ) latest ON fr.stock_code = latest.stock_code 
             AND fr.year = latest.max_year 
             AND fr.quarter = latest.max_quarter
    WHERE fr.ratio_code = 'ROE'
      AND fr.segment <> 'industry'
      AND fr.stock_code IN ('MWG', 'DHT', 'FRT', 'PSD', 'PET', 'DGW')
    ORDER BY fr.data DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    ts.stock_code,
    CONCAT(lq.year, '-Q', lq.quarter) as period_key,
    fr.data * 100 as return_pct
FROM top_stocks ts
CROSS JOIN latest_quarters lq
LEFT JOIN financial_ratio fr ON fr.stock_code = ts.stock_code 
    AND fr.ratio_code = 'ROE' 
    AND fr.year = lq.year 
    AND fr.quarter = lq.quarter
    AND fr.segment <> 'industry'
ORDER BY ts.stock_code, lq.year DESC, lq.quarter DESC

LIMIT 5

question_raw: Liệt kê tỷ suất sinh lời theo từng quý của mã cổ phiếu công ty PPC từ 2025-Q1 đến 2025-Q4.
question: Liệt kê tỷ suất sinh lời (điểm phần trăm) theo từng quý của cổ phiếu PPC (Công ty Cổ phần Nhiệt điện Phả Lại) từ 2025‑Q1 đến 2025‑Q4.
SQL:
WITH quarterly_boundaries AS (
    SELECT 
        '2025-Q1' AS period_key,
        '2025-01-01'::timestamp AS quarter_start,
        '2025-03-31'::timestamp AS quarter_end
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        '2025-Q2' AS period_key,
        '2025-04-01'::timestamp AS quarter_start,
        '2025-06-30'::timestamp AS quarter_end
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        '2025-Q3' AS period_key,
        '2025-07-01'::timestamp AS quarter_start,
        '2025-09-30'::timestamp AS quarter_end
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        '2025-Q4' AS period_key,
        '2025-10-01'::timestamp AS quarter_start,
        '2025-12-31'::timestamp AS quarter_end
),
quarterly_prices AS (
    SELECT 
        qb.period_key,
        (SELECT sd.close 
         FROM stock_daily sd 
         WHERE sd.stock_code = 'PPC' 
             AND sd.time >= qb.quarter_start 
             AND sd.time <= qb.quarter_end 
         ORDER BY sd.time ASC 
         LIMIT 1) AS start_price,
        (SELECT sd.close 
         FROM stock_daily sd 
         WHERE sd.stock_code = 'PPC' 
             AND sd.time >= qb.quarter_start 
             AND sd.time <= qb.quarter_end 
         ORDER BY sd.time DESC 
         LIMIT 1) AS end_price
    FROM quarterly_boundaries qb
)
SELECT 
    period_key,
    (end_price - start_price) / start_price * 100 AS return_pct
FROM quarterly_prices
WHERE start_price IS NOT NULL AND end_price IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY period_key;

question_raw: Trong quý 4 năm 2025, mức chênh lệch sinh lời giữa cổ phiếu DRI và VNINDEX là bao nhiêu điểm %?
question: Trong quý 4 năm 2025, chênh lệch lợi suất giữa cổ phiếu DRI (Công ty Cổ phần Đầu tư Cao su Đắk Lắk) và VN‑INDEX là bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH q4_2025_dri AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT stock_code, time, close
  FROM stock_daily 
  WHERE stock_code = 'DRI' 
    AND time >= '2025-10-01' 
    AND time <= '2025-12-31'
),
first_dri AS (
  SELECT close as start_price
  FROM q4_2025_dri
  WHERE time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM q4_2025_dri)
),
last_dri AS (
  SELECT close as end_price
  FROM q4_2025_dri
  WHERE time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM q4_2025_dri)
),
q4_2025_vnindex AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT index_name, time, close
  FROM indices_daily 
  WHERE index_name = 'VNINDEX' 
    AND time >= '2025-10-01' 
    AND time <= '2025-12-31'
),
first_vnindex AS (
  SELECT close as start_price
  FROM q4_2025_vnindex
  WHERE time = (SELECT MIN(time) FROM q4_2025_vnindex)
),
last_vnindex AS (
  SELECT close as end_price
  FROM q4_2025_vnindex
  WHERE time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM q4_2025_vnindex)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT end_price FROM last_dri) as dri_end,
  (SELECT start_price FROM first_dri) as dri_start,
  ((SELECT end_price FROM last_dri) - (SELECT start_price FROM first_dri)) * 100.0 / (SELECT start_price FROM first_dri) as dri_return_pct,
  (SELECT end_price FROM last_vnindex) as vnindex_end,
  (SELECT start_price FROM first_vnindex) as vnindex_start,
  ((SELECT end_price FROM last_vnindex) - (SELECT start_price FROM first_vnindex)) * 100.0 / (SELECT start_price FROM first_vnindex) as vnindex_return_pct,
  (((SELECT end_price FROM last_dri) - (SELECT start_price FROM first_dri)) * 100.0 / (SELECT start_price FROM first_dri)) - 
  (((SELECT end_price FROM last_vnindex) - (SELECT start_price FROM first_vnindex)) * 100.0 / (SELECT start_price FROM first_vnindex)) as spread_pct

question_raw: Liệt kê Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng theo từng quý của mã cổ phiếu ngân hàng BID và VN30 từ 2024-Q4 đến 2025-Q3.
question: Liệt kê Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng (điểm phần trăm) theo từng quý của cổ phiếu ngân hàng BID và VN30 từ quý 4/2024 đến quý 3/2025.
SQL:
WITH quarterly_boundaries AS (
    SELECT '2024-Q4' as period_key, '2024-10-01'::date as start_date, '2024-12-31'::date as end_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2025-Q1', '2025-01-01'::date, '2025-03-31'::date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2025-Q2', '2025-04-01'::date, '2025-06-30'::date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '2025-Q3', '2025-07-01'::date, '2025-09-30'::date
),
bid_quarterly AS (
    SELECT 
        qb.period_key,
        (SELECT close FROM stock_daily WHERE stock_code = 'BID' AND time::date >= qb.start_date AND time::date <= qb.end_date ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) as start_close,
        (SELECT close FROM stock_daily WHERE stock_code = 'BID' AND time::date >= qb.start_date AND time::date <= qb.end_date ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) as end_close
    FROM quarterly_boundaries qb
),
vn30_quarterly AS (
    SELECT 
        qb.period_key,
        (SELECT close FROM indices_daily WHERE index_name = 'VN30' AND time::date >= qb.start_date AND time::date <= qb.end_date ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) as start_close,
        (SELECT close FROM indices_daily WHERE index_name = 'VN30' AND time::date >= qb.start_date AND time::date <= qb.end_date ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) as end_close
    FROM quarterly_boundaries qb
)
SELECT 
    b.period_key,
    (b.end_close - b.start_close) * 100.0 / b.start_close as return_pct,
    (v.end_close - v.start_close) * 100.0 / v.start_close as benchmark_return_pct
FROM bid_quarterly b
JOIN vn30_quarterly v ON b.period_key = v.period_key
ORDER BY b.period_key

question: Vẽ biểu đồ đường hiển thị tỷ suất sinh lời theo quý (điểm phần trăm) cho 10 mã cổ phiếu hàng đầu của ngành Thực phẩm và Đồ uống trong 4 quý gần nhất.
SQL:
WITH top10_stocks AS (
    SELECT stock_code, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY data DESC) as rank
    FROM financial_ratio
    WHERE ratio_code = 'ROI' 
      AND segment <> 'industry'
      AND stock_code IN (SELECT stock_code FROM company_info WHERE industry = 'Food and Beverages')
      AND (year, quarter) = (
        SELECT year, quarter 
        FROM financial_ratio 
        WHERE ratio_code = 'ROI' 
          AND segment <> 'industry'
          AND stock_code IN (SELECT stock_code FROM company_info WHERE industry = 'Food and Beverages')
        ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC 
        LIMIT 1
      )
),
quarters_4 AS (
    SELECT year, quarter, 
           CONCAT(CAST(year AS TEXT), '-Q', CAST(quarter AS TEXT)) as period_key
    FROM (
        SELECT year, quarter
        FROM financial_ratio
        WHERE ratio_code = 'ROI'
          AND segment <> 'industry'
          AND stock_code IN (SELECT stock_code FROM company_info WHERE industry = 'Food and Beverages')
        GROUP BY year, quarter
        ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC
        LIMIT 4
    ) q
)
SELECT fr.stock_code, q.period_key, fr.data * 100 as return_pct
FROM financial_ratio fr
JOIN top10_stocks t ON fr.stock_code = t.stock_code
JOIN quarters_4 q ON fr.year = q.year AND fr.quarter = q.quarter
WHERE fr.ratio_code = 'ROI'
  AND fr.segment <> 'industry'
ORDER BY t.rank, q.year, q.quarter

question_raw: Liệt kê ROE theo từng quý của công ty chứng khoán DSE và mức trung bình ngành Dịch vụ Tài chính từ 2024-Q4 đến 2025-Q3.
question: Bạn có thể liệt kê ROE (điểm phần trăm) theo từng quý của công ty chứng khoán DSE và mức trung bình của ngành Dịch vụ Tài chính từ quý 4/2024 đến quý 3/2025 không?

WITH company_roe AS (

question_raw: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, chênh lệch tăng trưởng cổ phiếu KDH outperform hay underperform VNINDEX là bao nhiêu?
question: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, cổ phiếu KDH (Công ty Cổ phần Đầu tư và Kinh doanh nhà Khang Điền) tăng trưởng so với VNINDEX chênh lệch bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm? KDH outperform hay underperform VNINDEX?
SQL:
WITH kdh_q3 AS (
    SELECT 
        stock_code,
        time,
        close,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_start,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
    FROM stock_daily
    WHERE stock_code = 'KDH'
        AND time >= '2025-07-01'
        AND time < '2025-10-01'
),
vnindex_q3 AS (
    SELECT 
        index_name,
        time,
        close,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) as rn_start,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_end
    FROM indices_daily
    WHERE index_name = 'VNINDEX'
        AND time >= '2025-07-01'
        AND time < '2025-10-01'
),
kdh_start AS (
    SELECT close as start_price FROM kdh_q3 WHERE rn_start = 1
),
kdh_end AS (
    SELECT close as end_price FROM kdh_q3 WHERE rn_end = 1
),
vnindex_start AS (
    SELECT close as start_price FROM vnindex_q3 WHERE rn_start = 1
),
vnindex_end AS (
    SELECT close as end_price FROM vnindex_q3 WHERE rn_end = 1
)
SELECT 
    (kdh_end.end_price - kdh_start.start_price) * 100.0 / kdh_start.start_price as kdh_return_pct,
    (vnindex_end.end_price - vnindex_start.start_price) * 100.0 / vnindex_start.start_price as vnindex_return_pct,
    ((kdh_end.end_price - kdh_start.start_price) * 100.0 / kdh_start.start_price) - 
    ((vnindex_end.end_price - vnindex_start.start_price) * 100.0 / vnindex_start.start_price) as difference_pct
FROM kdh_start, kdh_end, vnindex_start, vnindex_end;

question_raw: Lấy dữ liệu để vẽ biểu đồ hiển  tỷ suất sinh lời theo quý cho top 10 mã cổ phiếu của ngành Ngân hàng trong 4 quý gần nhất.
question: Vẽ biểu đồ cột hiển thị tỷ suất sinh lời (điểm phần trăm) theo quý cho top 10 mã cổ phiếu ngân hàng trong 4 quý gần nhất.
SQL:
-- Get top 10 banks by latest ROE and their ROE for the 4 most recent quarters
WITH bank_stocks AS (
    SELECT stock_code 
    FROM company_info 
    WHERE is_bank = true
),
latest_quarter AS (
    SELECT MAX(year) as max_year, MAX(quarter) as max_quarter
    FROM financial_ratio 
    WHERE segment <> 'industry'
),
top_10_banks AS (
    SELECT fr.stock_code
    FROM financial_ratio fr
    JOIN bank_stocks bs ON fr.stock_code = bs.stock_code
    CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq
    WHERE fr.ratio_code = 'ROE'
        AND fr.segment <> 'industry'
        AND fr.year = lq.max_year
        AND fr.quarter = lq.max_quarter
    ORDER BY fr.data DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
recent_quarters AS (
    SELECT year, quarter
    FROM financial_ratio 
    WHERE segment <> 'industry'
    GROUP BY year, quarter
    ORDER BY year DESC, quarter DESC
    LIMIT 4
)
SELECT 
    fr.stock_code,
    fr.year || '-Q' || fr.quarter as period_key,
    fr.data * 100 as return_pct
FROM financial_ratio fr
JOIN top_10_banks t10 ON fr.stock_code = t10.stock_code
JOIN recent_quarters rq ON fr.year = rq.year AND fr.quarter = rq.quarter
WHERE fr.ratio_code = 'ROE'
    AND fr.segment <> 'industry'
ORDER BY fr.stock_code, fr.year DESC, fr.quarter DESC;

question_raw: Liệt kê ROE theo từng quý của công ty PAN và mức trung bình ngành Thực phẩm và Đồ uống từ 2025-Q1 đến 2025-Q4.
question: Bạn có thể cung cấp ROE (điểm phần trăm) của công ty PAN và mức trung bình của ngành Thực phẩm và Đồ uống cho từng quý từ 2025‑Q1 đến 2025‑Q4 không?

question_raw: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, chênh lệch tăng trưởng cổ phiếu SAB outperform hay underperform VN30 là bao nhiêu?
question: Trong quý 3 năm 2025, SAB (công ty bia, rượu và nước giải khát) tăng trưởng so với VN30 chênh lệch bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
-- Get SAB stock price at start and end of Q3 2025
WITH sab_prices AS (
  SELECT 
    time,
    close,
    stock_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) as rn_asc
  FROM stock_daily
  WHERE stock_code = 'SAB'
    AND time >= '2025-07-01'
    AND time <= '2025-09-30'
),
sab_start AS (
  SELECT close as start_price FROM sab_prices WHERE rn_asc = 1
),
sab_end AS (
  SELECT close as end_price FROM sab_prices WHERE rn_desc = 1
),
-- Get VN30 index value at start and end of Q3 2025
vn30_prices AS (
  SELECT 
    time,
    close,
    index_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) as rn_asc
  FROM indices_daily
  WHERE index_name = 'VN30'
    AND time >= '2025-07-01'
    AND time <= '2025-09-30'
),
vn30_start AS (
  SELECT close as start_price FROM vn30_prices WHERE rn_asc = 1
),
vn30_end AS (
  SELECT close as end_price FROM vn30_prices WHERE rn_desc = 1
)
SELECT 
  (s_end.end_price - s_start.start_price) * 100.0 / s_start.start_price as sab_return_pct,
  (v_end.end_price - v_start.start_price) * 100.0 / v_start.start_price as vn30_return_pct,
  ((s_end.end_price - s_start.start_price) * 100.0 / s_start.start_price) - 
  ((v_end.end_price - v_start.start_price) * 100.0 / v_start.start_price) as difference_pct_points
FROM sab_start s_start, sab_end s_end, vn30_start v_start, vn30_end v_end;

question_raw: Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng của đậu nành trong tháng 10 năm 2025 là bao nhiêu phần trăm?
question: Tỷ lệ tăng trưởng của ngành đậu nành trong tháng 10/2025 là bao nhiêu điểm phần trăm?
SQL:
WITH october_data AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time ASC) as rn_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) as rn_desc
    FROM commodities_daily
    WHERE indicator_code = 'ZS=F'
        AND time >= '2025-10-01'
        AND time < '2025-11-01'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT value FROM october_data WHERE rn_asc = 1) as start_value,
    (SELECT value FROM october_data WHERE rn_desc = 1) as end_value,
    ((SELECT value FROM october_data WHERE rn_desc = 1) - (SELECT value FROM october_data WHERE rn_asc = 1)) 
        / (SELECT value FROM october_data WHERE rn_asc = 1) * 100 as growth_rate_pct
FROM october_data
LIMIT 1;
